name: Jaspyr Stonebreach

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: If Jaspyr hits with an attack against a target granting combat advantage to him, he deals the target 2d6 extra damage.

traits.name: Stand the Ground
traits.details: Jaspyr can move 1 square fewer than the effect specifies when subjected to a pull, a push, or a slide.

traits.name: Steady-Footed
traits.details: Jaspyr can make a saving throw to avoid falling prone when an attack would knock him prone.

powers.name: Blessing of Hidden Steel
powers.requirements: Jaspyr must be in an obscured square.

effect.description: Jaspyr becomes invisible until he hits or misses with an attack or until he is no longer in an obscured square. While invisible as a result of this power, Jaspyr gains a +2 power bonus to attack rolls.

powers.name: Stick and Move
powers.requirements: Jaspyr must have hit this turn with an attack using Throat-Slitter.

effect.description: Jaspyr shifts up to his speed.

powers.name: Try Your Luck
powers.trigger: Jaspyr makes an attack roll and dislikes the result.

effect.description: Reroll the attack roll. Use the second roll, even if it’s lower.
